subsystems.name: Carbon-fixation core
subsystems.role: the enzyme set that turns CO₂ into organic carbon.

subsystems.name: Carbon-concentrating mechanism
subsystems.role: raises CO₂ around RuBisCO, because the enzyme is slow and is inhibited by oxygen.

subsystems.name: Mineralisation module
subsystems.role: converts the captured carbon into solid carbonate so it cannot easily return to the air.

subsystems.name: Energy and electron supply
subsystems.role: pays the large energy bill for fixing a dilute gas.

subsystems.role: keeps the organism in the reactor and out of the environment.

buildSteps.title: Pick a chassis
buildSteps.detail: Cyanobacteria are the natural choice because they already run photosynthesis and carbon concentrating mechanisms; fast-growing heterotrophs such as E. coli are easier to engineer but must be fed organic carbon, which can cancel the benefit.

buildSteps.title: Tune carbon fixation
buildSteps.detail: Overexpress RuBisCO and its chaperones, then rebalance the rest of the Calvin cycle so no intermediate becomes a bottleneck. Some work replaces RuBisCO altogether with faster synthetic fixation cycles built in the test tube.

buildSteps.title: Add or improve the carboxysome
buildSteps.detail: Encapsulate RuBisCO with carbonic anhydrase inside a protein shell, and add bicarbonate transporters at the cell membrane, so CO₂ is concentrated at the enzyme rather than escaping.

buildSteps.title: Attach a mineralisation step
buildSteps.detail: Display carbonic anhydrase on the cell surface or export it, and supply calcium or magnesium so that bicarbonate precipitates as carbonate. Urea-driven precipitation is avoided where possible because it releases its own CO₂ and ammonia.

buildSteps.title: Balance the energy budget
buildSteps.detail: Engineer the cell to divert enough ATP and reducing power into fixation without stalling growth. Growth-coupled selection and adaptive laboratory evolution are used to let faster mutants win.

buildSteps.title: Scale the culture
buildSteps.detail: Grow the strain in closed photobioreactors or open ponds, or inject it into crushed basalt and peridotite underground where the rock itself supplies the cations.

buildSteps.title: Engineer containment
buildSteps.detail: Build in dependence on a nutrient that does not exist in the wild, so the organism cannot survive if it escapes.

buildSteps.title: Prove the carbon is locked up
buildSteps.detail: Trace the captured carbon isotopically into the mineral, measure how much of it dissolves back, and account for the energy and materials used along the way.

prerequisites.tech: Synthetic biology toolkits for cyanobacteria and lithoautotrophs
prerequisites.why: E. coli is easy to engineer; the photosynthetic and rock-dwelling chassis that matter here are far less tractable.
functional carboxysomes have been rebuilt in non-native hosts, but not yet tuned for high flux at industrial scale.
the enzymes are well characterised and microbially induced carbonate precipitation is already used commercially for soil and concrete.

prerequisites.tech: Cheap low-carbon energy and cation supply
prerequisites.why: pumping, mixing and supplying calcium or magnesium can emit more CO₂ than the microbes remove if the power and minerals are not clean.

prerequisites.tech: Durable carbon accounting for biological storage
prerequisites.why: without standard verification, mineralised carbon cannot be counted or sold.

pathway.milestone: lab strains that fix CO₂ into biomass and carbonate, and commercial microbial carbonate precipitation for soils and concrete
pathway.unlocks: proof that the biochemistry works and early revenue from construction materials.

pathway.milestone: pilot bioreactors producing carbonate aggregate at tonne scale
pathway.unlocks: a real cost and energy figure per tonne of CO₂ stored.

pathway.milestone: microbially accelerated mineralisation in subsurface basalt and peridotite
pathway.unlocks: storage that does not depend on a reactor at the surface.

pathway.milestone: standard verification and life-cycle rules for microbial carbon removal
pathway.unlocks: deployment at climate scale — but only if the energy, cations and land use all come out ahead.
